correctness.rationale: For G=Z3 with μ total mass I, Fourier convolution gives B=μ̂(1) with B²=0, μ̂(2)=B*, and μ̂(0)=I. Every nonzero square-zero 2×2 complex matrix is unitarily similar to tE12, t=||B||>0. Fourier inversion yields A_j=(I+t ω^-j E12+t ω^j E21)/3, with eigenvalues (1±t)/3, hence positivity exactly 0≤t≤1. Direct symbolic calculation gives μ*μ=H, [A_j,A_k] eigenvalues ±i√3 t²/9 and each trace deviation 2t/3, total 2t. At t=1 atoms are rank one; for t>0 noncommutative. On Z2 the nontrivial Fourier coefficient Hermitian and square-zero forces zero; scalar Z3 likewise. Independently checked the matrix convolution products, PSD determinants (1−t²)/9, and commutator coefficient symbolically. This is a universal Fourier classification, not evidence from the finite parameter samples.
